Professional Summary 
Microsoft 365 and SharePoint Support Engineer with 4.3 years of experience in SharePoint Online, 
Microsoft 365 administration, Exchange Online, Power Automate, and Power Apps. Proven expertise 
in workflow migration, SharePoint data migration, storage optimization, and support for custom 
applications built on the Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, JavaScript forms, 
and dashboards, with strong adherence to SLA and compliance standards. 
 
Technical Skills 
• Microsoft 365: SharePoint Online Administration, Microsoft Teams, OneDrive for Business, Exchange 
Online, Office 365 Tenant Administration 
• Power Platform: Power Automate (Cloud Flows, Approvals, Error Handling), Power Apps (Canvas 
Apps – Basic) 
• SharePoint: Sites, Lists, Libraries, Metadata, Content Types, Versioning, JSON Formatting, Modern 
Pages, SPFx Support 
• Migration & Governance: ShareGate, SharePoint Data Migration, Storage Management, Audit 
Reports, Root Cause Analysis 
• Scripting & Automation: PowerShell (Basic Scripting, SharePoint/Microsoft 365 Administration, Task 
Automation) 
• Support & Operations: Application Support, Incident & Request Management, Documentation, User 
Training

Professional Experience 
Microsoft 365 & SharePoint Support Engineer 
Infosys – Hyderabad, India 
December 2021 – Present 
SharePoint & Power Platform Development 
• Migrated SharePoint 2013 Designer workflows to Power Automate, modernizing legacy automation and 
improving maintainability. 
• Designed, developed, tested, deployed, and supported Power Automate workflows including approval 
flows, notifications, and data updates. 
• Developed basic Canvas Apps using Power Apps to enable efficient data capture and workflow 
integration. 
• Customized SharePoint lists and forms (New, Edit, View) using JSON formatting to enhance usability 
and performance. 
• Supported SPFx components and modern SharePoint web parts as part of application customization 
activities. 
• Handled new SharePoint development requests and delivered scalable solutions aligned with business 
requirements. 
 
 
 
SharePoint Online Administration 
• Administered SharePoint Online site collections, managing permissions, external users, sharing policies, 
and access controls. 
• Created and maintained SharePoint sites, lists, and libraries with advanced configurations such as 
metadata, content types, and versioning. 
• Led SharePoint site creation, branding, and navigation setup to improve user experience and 
accessibility. 
• Managed SharePoint storage usage, implemented quota management, and executed archival strategies. 
• Ran SharePoint audit and storage reports, analyzed usage trends, and performed root cause analysis to 
optimize storage consumption. 
• Managed SharePoint Modern Page content, including page creation, web part configuration, permissions, 
and version control. Supported business users in publishing and maintaining content across SharePoint 
modern sites, ensuring content governance, consistency, and usability. 
 
• Executed SharePoint data migrations using ShareGate, ensuring data integrity, permission mapping, and 
minimal downtime. 
• Resolved SharePoint–Microsoft Teams integration issues, including file access errors, permission 
mismatches, and sync conflicts. 
• Provided end-user training and prepared technical documentation to improve adoption and reduce 
recurring support incidents. 
 
Exchange Online & Microsoft 365 Support 
• Created and managed shared mailboxes, distribution lists, and mail-enabled security groups. 
• Performed mail flow diagnostics using Message Trace and Exchange Admin Center to investigate delivery 
delays and failures. 
• Resolved Outlook issues including mailbox storage limits, calendar sync problems, and profile 
configuration issues. 
• Assisted users with calendar sharing, delegate access, and cross-device synchronization. 
• Supported OneDrive for Business access and sync issues, including file recovery and permission 
troubleshooting. 
• Monitored mailbox usage, applied retention policies, and supported archiving strategies. 
• Ensured compliance with organizational policies related to email retention, access management, and 
external sharing. 
 
 
Key Responsibilities Across Roles 
• Design, Development, Testing, Deployment, and Support (End-to-End) 
• Application Support and Incident Resolution 
• SharePoint Storage & Governance Management 
• Workflow Automation and Optimization 
• Documentation and Knowledge Transfer 
• End-User Support and Training 
• SLA Adherence and Stakeholder Communication
